title: saxifraga lingulata var. lantoscana
intro: Saxifraga lingulata var. lantoscana, commonly known as 'Lantoscana Saxifrage', is a plant species in the Saxifragaceae family. It is a perennial herb with potential medicinal properties. The plant is believed to have health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate conditions like arthritis and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Saxifraga lingulata var. lantoscana include iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and antispasmodic effects.
